regulatory_model.quote: Any person who is certified to practice as an anesthesiologist assistant in this State shall have the right to use the title "anesthesiologist assistant" and the abbreviation "A.A." No other person may assume that title or use that abbreviation, or any other words, letters, signs, or devices to indicate that the person using them is an anesthesiologist assistant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring certification or its renewal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring an anesthesiologist assistant certificate or in connection with applying for or procuring a periodic renewal of an anesthesiologist assistant certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Occupational advertising that is intended or has a tendency to deceive the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: occupational advertising that is intended or has a tendency to deceive the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising undue influence on or taking improper advantage of a person using the assistant's services, or promoting sale of services in an exploitative manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: exercising undue influence on, or taking improper advantage of, a person using the anesthesiologist assistant's services, or promoting the sale of professional goods or services in a manner that exploits a person for the financial gain of the anesthesiologist assistant or of a third party

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with provisions of federal or State statutes or rules governing the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to comply with provisions of federal or State statutes or rules governing the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime related to the profession or conviction of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime related to the profession or conviction of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that evidences unfitness to practice in the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct that evidences unfitness to practice in the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing false professional reports or records, or impeding proper filing, or failing to file proper records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making or filing false professional reports or records, impeding or obstructing the proper making or filing of professional reports or records, or failing to file the proper professional report or record

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing the profession when mentally or physically unfit to do so.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing the profession when mentally or physically unfit to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to practice competently, including performance of unsafe patient care or failure to conform to essential standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to practice competently by reason of any cause on a single occasion or on multiple occasions constitutes unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting and performing responsibilities the person knows or has reason to know they are not competent to perform.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepting and performing responsibilities that the person knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any material misrepresentation in the practice of the profession, by commission or omission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making any material misrepresentation in the practice of the profession, whether by commission or omission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holding oneself out as, or permitting oneself to be represented as, a licensed physician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the act of holding one's self out as, or permitting one's self to be represented as, a licensed physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing otherwise than at the direction and under the supervision of an anesthesiologist licensed by the Board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performing otherwise than at the direction and under the supervision of an anesthesiologist licensed by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting delegation of, or performing or offering to perform, a task beyond the person's scope of practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepting the delegation of, or performing or offering to perform, a task or tasks beyond the person's scope of practice as defined by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any controlled substance other than as authorized by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: administering, dispensing, or prescribing any controlled substance other than as authorized by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with an order of the Board or violating any term or condition of a restricted certification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to comply with an order of the Board or violating any term or condition of a certification restricted by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, education, or credentials.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: delegating professional responsibilities to a person whom the certified professional knows, or has reason to know, is not qualified by training, experience, education, or licensing credentials to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated failure to use that degree of care, skill, and proficiency commonly exercised by an ordinarily skillful professional.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross failure to use and exercise on a particular occasion or the failure to use and exercise on repeated occasions that degree of care, skill, and proficiency which is commonly exercised by the ordinary skillful, careful, and prudent professional engaged in similar practice under the same or similar conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that impair the ability to provide medical services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that impair the anesthesiologist assistant's ability to provide medical services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation of certification to practice as an anesthesiologist assistant in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revocation of certification to practice as an anesthesiologist assistant in another jurisdiction on one or more of the grounds specified in subdivisions (1)-(19) of this subsection

citations.cite: § 1663. Notice of use of anesthesiologist assistants

definition_quote.value: A person certified by the State of Vermont under this chapter who is qualified by education, training, experience, and personal character to provide medical services under the direction and supervision of an anesthesiologist.
definition_quote.quote: "Anesthesiologist assistant" means a person certified by the State of Vermont under this chapter who is qualified by education, training, experience, and personal character to provide medical services under the direction and supervision of an anesthesiologist.

value: medical services under the direction and supervision of an anesthesiologist
duties delegated by supervising anesthesiologist within scope of practice
methods_authorized.quote: The anesthesiologist assistant's scope of practice shall be limited to that delegated to the anesthesiologist assistant by the supervising anesthesiologist and for which the anesthesiologist assistant is qualified by education, training, and experience.

drug_authority.value: May administer, dispense, or prescribe controlled substances only as authorized by law; unauthorized administration, dispensing, or prescribing is unprofessional conduct.
drug_authority.quote: administering, dispensing, or prescribing any controlled substance other than as authorized by law

supervising_anesthesiologist_ratio.quote: The number of anesthesiologist assistants permitted to practice under the direction and supervision of a physician shall be determined by the Board after review of the system of care delivery in which the supervising anesthesiologist and anesthesiologist assistants propose to practice.

supervising_anesthesiologist_physical_pr.quote: At a minimum, supervision shall mean that an anesthesiologist is readily available at the facility for consultation and intervention.

written_practice_protocol_required.quote: Applications for certification shall be accompanied by a protocol signed by the proposed supervising anesthesiologist and a copy of the anesthesiologist assistant employment contract.

value: medical services delegated by supervising anesthesiologist within the anesthesiologist assistant's education, training, and experience
activities relating to medical care and treatment carried out by custom and usage under control of the anesthesiologist
authorized_anesthesia_tasks.quote: The anesthesiologist assistant's scope of practice shall be limited to that delegated to the anesthesiologist assistant by the supervising anesthesiologist and for which the anesthesiologist assistant is qualified by education, training, and experience. At no time shall the practice of the anesthesiologist assistant exceed the normal scope of the supervising anesthesiologist's practice.

supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.value: Licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy and either has completed an approved residency in anesthesiology or is credentialed by a hospital to practice anesthesiology full time.
supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.quote: "Anesthesiologist" means a person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy under chapter 23 or 33 of this title and who either has completed a residency in anesthesiology approved by the American Board of Anesthesiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Anesthesiology or their predecessors or successors or is credentialed by a hospital to practice anesthesiology and engages in the practice of anesthesiology at that hospital full time.

national_certification_body.value: National Commission for Certification of Anesthesiologist Assistants (NCCAA)
national_certification_body.quote: "NCCAA" means the National Commission for Certification of Anesthesiologist Assistants, or its successor, as recognized by the Board.

accredited_training_program_required.quote: obtained a master's degree from a board-approved anesthesiologist assistant program at an institution of higher education accredited by the Committee on Allied Health Education and Accreditation, the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs, or their successor agencies

continuing_certification_required_for_re.quote: submit proof of current active NCCAA certification

supervising_anesthesiologist_liability.quote: The supervising anesthesiologist delegating activities to an anesthesiologist assistant shall be legally liable for such activities of the anesthesiologist assistant, and the anesthesiologist assistant shall in this relationship be the anesthesiologist's agent.

patient_disclosure_required.quote: An anesthesiologist that utilizes the services of an anesthesiologist assistant shall post a notice to that effect in an appropriate place and include language in the patient consent form that the anesthesiologist uses an anesthesiologist assistant.
patient_disclosure_required.citation: § 1663. Notice of use of anesthesiologist assistants
